description: Header file defining the DataElementFile class, which manages file data elements including file operations, validation, and memory mapping within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: Represents a data element associated with a file, providing methods for file management, validation, and memory mapping.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the file.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open and valid.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Returns a reference to the File object representing the file.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Retrieves the error code from the file operations.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Gets the user ID associated with a username.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Gets the group ID associated with a group name.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Gets the permission bits for a given mode.

methods.name: Unlink
methods.description: Removes the file from the filesystem.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Reallocates memory for the file data.

methods.name: OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Opens a memory-mapped file with required size.
